custom_intro: Datatoool builds modern, professional, and tailored software solutions.
custom_body: We design cloud, multi-user, and mobile systems to help your business grow. Whether you are a small entrepreneur or a consolidated company, we offer solutions adapted to your needs.
benefit_cloud_desc: Access securely from anywhere with scalability.
benefit_multiuser_desc: Collaborate in real time with your team.
benefit_mobile_desc: Manage your business from your phone.
guest_message:
Add your products and control your inventory.

faq_q1: How can I create a support ticket?
faq_a1: Go to Help & Support > Submit a Ticket and complete the form.
faq_q2: Where can I find the privacy policy?
faq_a2: In Help & Support > Privacy Policy you can read the details.
faq_q3: How do I update my profile information?
faq_a3: In Settings > Profile you can edit your data.
faq_q4: What should I do if I forgot my password?
faq_a4: Use the 'Forgot Password' option on the login screen to reset it.

premium_inventory_migration_desc: Simplify your inventory upload and sync your data in the cloud.
premium_excel_desc: Download the template, fill in your products, and upload them in seconds.
premium_systems_desc: Convert your physical inventory to digital without losing data.
premium_sync_desc: Easily share your data. Your products and records are not limited to your phone: with the premium solution you can also have them on your personal computer, laptop, and online. Your inventory is available on all your devices, wherever you are. 👉 To activate this option and configure synchronization, please contact us. StockMaster ensures everything works securely and seamlessly.
add_user_info_content: When you add a new user, they join the same company inventory. This means all users share the same database and can view and work with the same products. Any changes made by one user are automatically synchronized so everyone has updated information.
add_user_explanation: By adding a new user, they join the same inventory and share information with the rest of the company. This way, everyone can work together and changes are automatically synchronized across devices.
add_user_exists: This user already exists. Check your email to confirm or request a new code.
